title: Destruction Particles
description: [Note: This component is currently experimental]. Sets the particles that will be used when block is destroyed.

tint_method.title: Tint Method
tint_method.description: Tint multiplied to the color. Tint method logic varies, but often refers to the "rain" and "temperature" of the biome the block is placed in to compute the tint.

particle_count.title: Particle Count
particle_count.description: Optional, number of particles to spawn of destruction. Default is 100, maximum is 255 inclusively

texture.title: Texture
texture.description: The texture name used for the particle.
